column3: BSB renders “from my forefathers” as “as did my forefathers.”
BSB reorders the clauses (“Recalling your tears, I long to see you”).
BSB renders “having taken remembrance” as “I am reminded” and starts a new sentence.
Close to the Greek; “fan into flame” renders “kindle anew.”
BSB renders “suffer together” as “join me in suffering.”
BSB starts a new sentence (“He has saved us”) and renders “before eternal times” as “before time began.”
BSB adds “He has revealed this grace” and “the way to,” and renders “brought to light” as “illuminated.”
BSB follows the critical text with “a teacher” without “of the Gentiles,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB adds “even though” and “to Him”; “what I have entrusted to Him” renders “my deposit.”
BSB adds “with the help of”; “the treasure entrusted” renders “the good deposit.”
BSB renders “to find mercy from the Lord” as “His mercy” and supplies the name “Onesiphorus”; “to me” is added.
